bit0_high.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time to hold the data line high for a `0` bit.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

bit0_low.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time to hold the data line low for a `0` bit.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

bit1_high.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time to hold the data line high for a `1` bit.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

bit1_low.docs:
**[Time](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The time to hold the data line low for a `1` bit.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

chipset.docs:
**enum**: The chipset to apply known timings from.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

is_rgbw.docs:
**boolean**: Set to `true` if the strip is RGBW. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

num_leds.docs:
**int**: The number of LEDs in the strip.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the data line of the light.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

pio.docs:
**int**: The PIO peripheral to use. If using multiple strips, you can use up to 4 strips per PIO. Must be one of `0` or `1`.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*

rgb_order.docs:
**string**: The RGB order of the strip.

*See also: [RP2040 PIO LED Strip](https://next.esphome.io/components/light/rp2040_pio_led_strip#configuration-variables)*
